newsitem.title: UK: Blair optimistic on N Ireland peace process-aide.
newsitem.headline: Blair optimistic on N Ireland peace process-aide.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair is hopeful he will be able to make progress in the peace process in Northern Ireland, his aides said on Friday.
They were commenting on a 15-minute phone call which Blair had earlier with Irish Prime Minister Bertie Ahern.
Describing the conversation between the two men as "friendly and positive", one aide said: "He feels relatively optimistic that he will be able to move the peace process forward."

The aide said there was no particular reason for the call being made on Friday, adding the two men did not discuss the incident overnight in which security forces blew up a vehicle parked near an hotel in County Fermanagh.
